desk-look panes now sit on a lighter gray than message bubbles, so a pane covering half the screen no longer looks heavy.

- With an Omarchy theme, the pane background used the same gray as user message bubbles (5.5% darker than the terminal background on light themes, 8% lighter on dark ones). Spread over a whole pane it read too dark. Panes now use their own, lighter shade: 3% on light themes and 4.5% on dark ones. Bubbles, code block backgrounds and mode chips keep their color. In 256-color terminals the pane shade is snapped to the nearest palette gray, like the bubble
- desk-asana, desk-slack, desk-plan and desk-review move to 0.79.1 with no changes

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
